text:
Maya (CS Ops): kicking off a 2-week contact audit sprint to tackle stale contacts and healthscore drift. Goal: reduce false-risk flags by ~30% and clean ~20k stale contacts. Plan: 1) identify stale contacts, 2) reconcile duplicates, 3) re-run healthscore baseline and add playbook gating. Who can own dedupe run + playbook gating change?

Arjun Gupta: I'll own the dedupe run. Q: what's our canonical dedupe key — email + company? do we want fuzzy name matching too? I suggest a canary on accounts <$500 MRR first.

Lena Park: sgtm for canary. Can we track a metric: "healthscore delta after recontact" (pre vs 30d post)? Also we should push a webhook to the playbook when contact is reactivated. Example quick query for stale contacts:```sql
SELECT id, email, company, last_seen
FROM contacts
WHERE last_seen < now() - interval '365 days'
LIMIT 1000;
```

Samir Khan: timeline question — are we doing a rolling 2-week window or a concentrated 3-day run? I'm ok to schedule a dedupe maintenance window Thu 03:00 PST (low traffic). Need rollback plan and owners.

Maya (CS Ops): @Arjun thanks. @Lena can you add the webhook spec and the playbook gating change to the doc? I'll draft a runbook with rollback steps. Owners for now: dedupe = @Arjun Gupta, playbook/webhook = @Lena Park, monitoring/alerts = @Samir Khan.

onboard-bot: Scheduled job "contact-audit-canary" completed: scanned 1,200 contacts, flagged 18% as stale (dry-run).

Arjun Gupta: saw the canary output — sample looks reasonable. I'll prepare the dedupe dry-run and share results in #cs-ops-reports. Planning to execute the dedupe Thu 03:00 PST as discussed (dry-run first, then commit).

Lena Park: added webhook spec and playbook gating change to the planning doc (link: https://go/source-docs/placeholder). Also added an eval: compare pre/post healthscore on the canary sample and report distribution shift.

Samir Khan: :thumbsup: please include explicit rollback steps in the runbook: 1) disable webhook/rule, 2) revert playbook config, 3) restore contacts from backup table. Also add an alert if >5% of active contacts see a negative score delta (so we can stop fast).

Maya (CS Ops): agreed. I'll open a JIRA ticket and assign tasks (dedupe, webhook, monitoring). Anyone want to pair on smoke tests tomorrow morning? @Arjun?

Arjun Gupta: can do 11:00 AM PT.

Lena Park: I'll join the 11:00 AM test as well.

Maya (CS Ops): perfect — I'll finalize the runbook and post the ticket. moving planning into the doc now, will ping again after the dry-run results. Thanks all!
